description: The 24 prompt patterns from thinkhard.si: small moves that change the answer, such as giving the facts, naming the reader, showing one example, setting a length, fencing off pasted text or asking for reasoning first. Each comes with when it helps, when it does not, a before-and-after pair with scores, and the line to add. Ask by a pattern's name or by what you want the prompt to do better; leave the query empty to list all 24.

query.description: A pattern's name, or what to improve, such as "stop it inventing numbers" or "answers are too generic". Leave it out to list every pattern.

name: get_prompt_pattern

patterns.description: Best match first; all 24 when no query is given.

group.description: Which part of a prompt it works on.

title: Get a prompt pattern
